ContactingˆsupportˆHere'sˆhowˆtoˆreachˆus.ˆ##ˆChatˆinˆtheˆappˆTapˆHelp,ˆthenˆMessageˆus.ˆChatˆisˆopenˆaroundˆtheˆclock,ˆeveryˆday.ˆIt'sˆtheˆfastestˆwayˆtoˆreachˆus,ˆandˆweˆalreadyˆknowˆit'sˆyouˆbecauseˆyou'reˆsignedˆin.ˆ##ˆPhoneˆCallˆ+1ˆ555ˆ0142ˆfromˆ8:00ˆAMˆETˆtoˆ8:00ˆPMˆET,ˆeveryˆday.ˆYou'llˆbeˆaskedˆtoˆconfirmˆaˆcodeˆinˆtheˆappˆtoˆproveˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆEmailˆEmailˆsupport@tallowbrook.exampleˆifˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆWeˆreplyˆbyˆemail,ˆbutˆforˆyourˆsecurityˆweˆcan'tˆmakeˆchangesˆtoˆyourˆaccountˆbyˆemail.ˆ##ˆSpecialistˆteamsˆSomeˆrequestsˆgoˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteam,ˆsuchˆasˆFraud,ˆDisputesˆorˆVerification.ˆTheyˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆBewareˆofˆfakesˆOnlyˆuseˆtheˆcontactˆdetailsˆinˆtheˆappˆorˆonˆthisˆhelpˆcenter.ˆScammersˆpostˆfakeˆsupportˆnumbersˆonline.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="account-eligibility">
WhoˆcanˆopenˆanˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆopenˆaˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆifˆyou:ˆ-ˆAreˆatˆleastˆ18ˆyearsˆoldˆ-ˆLiveˆinˆtheˆUSˆandˆhaveˆaˆUSˆresidentialˆaddressˆ(notˆaˆPOˆbox)ˆ-ˆHaveˆaˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITINˆ-ˆHaveˆanˆunexpiredˆgovernment-issuedˆphotoˆIDˆ-ˆHaveˆaˆsmartphoneˆthatˆcanˆrunˆtheˆTallowbrookˆappˆ##ˆOpeningˆanˆaccountˆDownloadˆtheˆappˆandˆtapˆGetˆstarted.ˆYou'llˆenterˆyourˆdetails,ˆtakeˆaˆphotoˆofˆyourˆIDˆandˆaˆselfie.ˆEveryˆaccountˆstartsˆonˆBasic,ˆandˆyouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆonceˆyou'reˆverified.ˆ##ˆOneˆaccountˆperˆpersonˆEachˆpersonˆcanˆhaveˆoneˆTallowbrookˆaccount.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆjointˆaccounts,ˆbusinessˆaccountsˆorˆaccountsˆforˆpeopleˆunderˆ18.ˆ##ˆLivingˆabroadˆIfˆyouˆmoveˆabroadˆpermanently,ˆyouˆmayˆneedˆtoˆcloseˆyourˆaccount.ˆTellˆusˆbeforeˆyouˆmove.ˆ##ˆPreviouslyˆclosedˆbyˆusˆIfˆTallowbrookˆclosedˆanˆaccountˆofˆyoursˆinˆtheˆpast,ˆaˆnewˆapplicationˆmayˆbeˆdeclined.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="products-checks">
Checkbooks,ˆcashier'sˆchecksˆandˆmoneyˆordersˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆpaperˆcheckbooks,ˆcashier'sˆchecksˆorˆmoneyˆorders.ˆ##ˆPayingˆsomeoneˆwhoˆneedsˆaˆcheckˆOptionsˆincludeˆBrookPayˆ(ifˆthey'reˆaˆTallowbrookˆmember),ˆanˆACHˆtransferˆtoˆtheirˆbankˆaccount,ˆorˆaˆwire.ˆManyˆlandlordsˆacceptˆACH.ˆ##ˆDepositingˆchecksˆYouˆcanˆdepositˆpaperˆchecksˆmadeˆoutˆtoˆyouˆbyˆtakingˆaˆphotoˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSeeˆ"Depositingˆaˆcheckˆinˆtheˆapp".ˆ##ˆMoneyˆordersˆWeˆcan'tˆissueˆmoneyˆorders,ˆandˆmoneyˆordersˆcan'tˆbeˆdepositedˆthroughˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆClosingˆbalanceˆchecksˆTheˆonlyˆtimeˆweˆmailˆaˆcheckˆisˆwhenˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccountˆwithoutˆaˆlinkedˆexternalˆaccount.ˆWeˆsendˆtheˆremainingˆbalanceˆbyˆcheck.ˆ##ˆDirectˆdepositˆformsˆthatˆaskˆforˆaˆvoidedˆcheckˆUseˆtheˆpre-filledˆdirectˆdepositˆformˆinˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆItˆhasˆeverythingˆaˆvoidedˆcheckˆwouldˆshow.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
